name: Prismbaton
description: Wait with the baton on the strike track and the free hand on the guard track, qi settling in both forearms.

name: Vigor Rapidrap
description: Pace forward left foot then right in an even rhythm that matches the two tracks of the hands.

name: Bedrock Sidebar
description: Rap the baton down the strike track onto the opponent's forearm while the guard hand stays up.

name: Stun Reliquary
description: Catch the opponent's wrist in the guard hand and lay the baton over it, so that both tracks hold one limb.

name: Billytroth
description: Cross the two tracks over the opponent's arm and jolt downward with a pulse of qi, loosening the hold.

name: Gloomcapend
description: Lean on baton and free hand together over the shoulder, spreading the pressure over two lines of qi.

name: Retribution Lanyardloop
description: Cut the baton onto the elbow nerve while the guard hand presses the wrist, sealing the arm's qi along both tracks.

name: Tenetbaton
description: Swap the baton between hands three times in a run of blows, the strike track becoming guard and back again.

name: Eclipse Batongrip
description: Take the opponent's blow on the guard track and return it on the strike track in the same line.

name: Unrivaled Vacuum Shortstick
description: Gather both tracks in one blow: the strike track breaks through the guard while the guard track seals the arm.

name: Weightend Troth
description: Stand with the arms rounded in a basin-shaped ring and the baton resting in its curve.

name: Skyborne Hardwood
description: Step in matched pairs with a partner or with one's own shadow, never leaving the court line.

name: Quenched Gripwrap
description: Tap the baton against the outer rim of the opponent's guard and glide off along the curve.

name: Squallbilly
description: Slap a blow aside with the baton and the open hand in two matching beats, one qi pulse behind each.

name: Venombaton
description: Hook the opponent's wrist and drag their weight downward into the basin of their own stance.

name: Switchvow
description: Wring the wrist between baton and palm in opposite directions, qi tightening the twist.

name: Authoritative Truncheon
description: Close the ring over the opponent's shoulders and press down with steady qi until the stance sinks.

name: Vacuumtick
description: Cut down into the centre of the guard as it rounds, caving it in and reaching the body behind.

name: Sigilcuff
description: Seal two nerves in two beats, the baton on the elbow and the palm on the wrist.

name: Tick Verdict
description: Pour out a run of blows that overflows the opponent's guard on every side, one wave after the other.

name: Sigilbilly
description: After gathering qi in the ring, strike and seal together in one beat so the court pair closes the basin over the opponent.

name: Steelbilly
description: Wait in a quiet guard, the baton held low like a hawk's wing over running water.

name: Spectral Switch
description: Skim forward on the balls of the feet like a bird low over the river.

name: Quenched Balanceknob
description: Let the baton fall unseen from above the opponent's eyeline onto the guard hand.

name: Inviolate Weightend
description: Bend the guard back like a reed under a current and let the blow pass over.

name: Hampering Cuff
description: Hitch the baton over the wrist like a talon and draw it close to the body.

name: Peal Rapidrap
description: Drag the opponent's arm round a curve and spill their balance into the turn.

name: Millstone Gripwrap
description: Hover the baton above the shoulder and let its weight settle gently, keeping the opponent still under a warning.

name: Entropy Crackdown
description: Beat the baton twice against the elbow in quick succession, folding the arm.

name: Shortstick Banner
description: Stoop from above in a steep dive that carries qi through the raised guard to the collarbone.

name: Tyrannous Stun
description: Land on the shoulder nerve from above in a falling beat that holds the arm's qi shut.

name: Pulsar Crackdown
description: Ride the current of a swift step across the gap and strike before the opponent sees the baton move.

name: Triumphant Sidebar Verdict
description: Hover through a held breath, then fall in one dive that carries the river's whole weight through the baton.

name: Steelcapend
description: Hold the baton in a stern, still posture that gives the opponent no reading of intent.

name: Ethereal Capend
description: Pace forward at an exact length, each step the same as the last.

name: Sovereign Batongrip
description: Rap the offending hand once, crisply, and return to the starting posture.

name: Batonpledge
description: Lever the wrist back across the baton and hold the arm in a straight line.

name: Peal Cuff
description: Jolt two points at once, the baton on the shoulder and the knuckle on the elbow.

name: Imperious Lanyardloop
description: Pin the opponent against a post or table with the baton and keep them there with level qi pressure.

name: Thunderclap Truncheon
description: Break a guard in good order with a direct thrust that shatters its form from the centre.

name: Volition Balanceknob
description: Seal the arm in two stages, the nerve at the wrist and then the elbow.

name: Consecrated Gripwrap
description: Let the opponent's strike land on the guard and send its full force back to the attacker's own shoulder.

name: Despotic Tick Troth
description: After a held pause that gathers qi, strike and seal the arm with one blow that ends the contest.

name: Batongrip Troth
description: Stand with a cool azure field of qi spread round the body and the baton resting in it.

name: Bedrock Hardwood
description: Glide into range with the field leading the body, so the baton arrives in a calm line.

name: Haemal Truncheon
description: Tap the outer edge of the forearm with a clean sound, the field keeping the baton true.

name: Deluge Shortstick
description: Let the blow slip along the field's edge and off the baton.

name: Cording Rapidrap
description: Hook the wrist with the baton and let the field close round the hand.

name: Venom Sidebar
description: Send a jolt of qi from the baton's tip into the elbow, folding the arm.

name: Volition Weightend
description: Lay the field's weight over the shoulder through the baton and keep it there.

name: Entropy Balanceknob
description: Pull the opponent's arm downward through the field, dropping their stance.

name: Vacuum Cuff
description: Push the field through the guard behind the baton tip, so the blow lands deep.

name: Sigiltick
description: Hold the baton against the elbow and let the field close over the arm, sealing its qi.

name: Pulsarcapend
description: Flash across the field to the opponent's side and strike in the same instant.

name: Vaunted Prism Stun
description: Gather the field overhead and bring it down through the baton, breaking the guard and pressing the opponent to the ground.

name: Billyvow
description: Rest the baton against the shoulder and let the Core's slow pulse steady the whole stance.

name: Agile Switch
description: Glide under the opponent's raised arm like a river under a bridge.

name: Fearless Capend
description: Time a rap to the Core's pulse so that the blow lands with the beat's full weight.

name: Authoritative Capend
description: Catch the wrist on the baton with the Core's pull behind the hand.

name: Peremptory Switch
description: Jolt the baton against the arm on the opponent's own heartbeat, spoiling their rhythm.

name: Statute Crackdown
description: Press the baton down with the slow weight of deep water until the stance sinks.

name: Authoritative Hardwood
description: Hook the arm and drag with a rising tide of qi from the Core, pulling the opponent off balance.

name: Cufftriumph
description: Thrust along a flood line from the Core through the shaft, driving into the body behind the guard.

name: Volition Lanyardloop
description: Strike the nerve at the shoulder and seal the arm's qi with a pulse from the Core.

name: Quenched Switch
description: Burst the opponent's guard like a river breaking its banks, the baton carrying the surge through the arm.

name: Cuff Banner
description: Gather the Core's flow at the baton's tip, striking through the guard while a ring of qi covers the bearer.

name: Solid Weightend
description: Begin with the baton held at the hip and the face turned into the wind.

name: Lithe Shortstick
description: Pace forward into the wind with short, firm steps and the weight settled low.

name: Squallswitch
description: Rap once at the weapon hand, the blow that the oath allows before any other.

name: Fettering Hardwood
description: Hitch the baton round the opponent's wrist and draw it to the bearing.

name: Venomswitch
description: Jolt the elbow with a gust of qi through the baton's tip, breaking the swing.

name: Gloomstun
description: Bear down on the shoulders with the baton and a steady qi weight until the opponent lies flat.

name: Stately Sidebar
description: Cross the baton over the bearing line to turn a blow away without leaving the line.

name: Destiny Tick
description: Strike the nerve above the elbow with a gale-fast rap, sealing the arm's qi.

name: Tenet Balanceknob
description: Run through four blows on one bearing, each softer than the last, so the opponent may yield at any point.

name: Revered Capend
description: Take a rush on the baton and let the wind of the oath turn its force back on the attacker.

name: Statute Gripwrap
description: Speak the oath aloud while holding the opponent's arm sealed and bound, letting qi carry the words and keep the hold.

name: Prism Truncheon
description: Stand broad and low as on the plateau, baton lowered, ready to restrain.

name: Deluge Rapidrap
description: Walk along the edge of the opponent's reach, close enough to answer and far enough to avoid.

name: Sovereign Lanyardloop
description: Rap along the bearing at the nearest forearm and step off the line.

name: Thrallcuff
description: Drag the wrist along the bearing past the opponent's hip, taking the arm with it.

name: Ruling Batongrip
description: Jolt the arm sharply to make the oath's first warning felt.

name: Stun Seal
description: Pin the arm flat to the ground, as to a plateau, and hold it there with even qi.

name: Statute Stun
description: Seal the wrist nerve with a measured rap that the oath permits.

name: Royal Tick
description: Break along the bearing through a raised guard, qi following the shaft into the chest.

name: Weightend Heraldry
description: Flash along the held bearing and bind the arm at the end of the step.

name: Quenched Crackdown
description: Hold the last bearing through a long breath, then drive the blow along it and seal the arm that receives it.

name: Firm Truncheon
description: Rest with the baton upright beside the shoulder, a watcher's posture that shows readiness without threat.

name: Vigor Switch
description: Pace the line of watch at an even stride, turning on the heel at each end.

name: Bedrock Shortstick
description: Rap the offending hand with a calm face and an even breath.

name: Parity Capend
description: Block with no haste, the baton simply arriving where the blow will be.

name: Thrall Batongrip
description: Hook the baton under the arm and draw the opponent to the line of watch.

name: Authoritative Rapidrap
description: Jolt the wrist from the side to break the grip on a weapon.

name: Gloom Lanyardloop
description: Press the shoulder down slowly and hold it, the pressure matched to the opponent's struggle.

name: Tickpledge
description: Hook the baton behind the ankle and ease the opponent to the ground.

name: Sigil Gripwrap
description: Strike the nerve at the elbow with a qi-bright rap, sealing the arm until the watch is over.

name: Symphonic Cuff
description: Chain a hook, a press and a seal in one even run, each following the last without a pause.

name: Prismbilly
description: Take the blow on the baton and give it back through the same line, no harder than it came.

name: Unbending Hardwood
description: Hold the baton across the line of watch and let qi flow through it so that nothing passes and nothing is struck.

name: Capendtroth
description: Stand with the baton level and no wall at the back, the guard covering all sides.

name: Deluge Tick
description: Step wide and low in open ground like a gale crossing a field.

name: Haemalbaton
description: Tap the knuckles with the baton's tip as the gale's first warning.

name: Hobbling Capend
description: Hook the arm and turn the opponent across open ground, where they have nowhere to brace.

name: Sidebar Troth
description: Jolt the opponent's lead hip with the butt of the baton, breaking their stance.

name: Statute Hardwood
description: Lean into the baton like a gale on a tree, driving the opponent down.

name: Thunderclap Crackdown
description: Hook the ankle in a sudden turn and let the opponent fall like fruit in the wind.

name: Pulsar Sidebar
description: Reach past the guard in a long stride and break through it with the baton's tip.

name: Masterful Balanceknob
description: Cut the baton onto the shoulder nerve with the weight of a gale, sealing the arm's qi.

name: Pulsar Stun
description: Let the wind carry the step across open ground in a flash and strike on arrival.

name: Famed Switch Decree
description: Sweep the baton in a wide gust that drives attackers back in open ground, then seal the nearest arm.

name: Prism Gripwrap
description: Hold the baton in a field that stirs like a light wind round the body.

name: Tickodyssey
description: Glide with the field, moving as if the body had been blown forward.

name: Squall Balanceknob
description: Rap the arm with the field's soft push behind the baton.

name: Cuffvow
description: Hook the arm and let the field draw it in like an eddy.

name: Peal Batongrip
description: Jolt the elbow with a sudden gust of the field through the baton.

name: Statute Shortstick
description: Pin the arm under a steady wind of qi that grows heavier the more the opponent struggles.

name: Steel Tick
description: Send the field through the guard like a gust through a gap, the baton following.

name: Capendpledge
description: Hold the field over the arm like still air and seal its qi until the hold is released.

name: Eclipse Truncheon
description: Let the opponent's strike drive into the field and be returned to them on the same line.

name: Volition Rapidrap
description: Raise a standing wind of qi round the opponent that presses them still, then drive the baton through its centre.

name: Solid Lanyardloop
description: Rest in a low guard with the Core's warmth steadying the arms like a plateau against wind.

name: Squallcapend
description: Stride with the weight carried in the Core, each foot falling heavy and sure.

name: Batonverdict
description: Hold the breath and cut the baton across the forearm with the Core's surge behind it.

name: Deluge Lanyardloop
description: Turn the blow to the wind side with a short flick of the baton.

name: Thrallstun
description: Hook the arm onto the bearing, the Core pulling with the whole body.

name: Entropy Truncheon
description: Jolt the wrist with a surge from the Core, knocking the grip open.

name: Gloom Cuff
description: Press the shoulder under a slow heavy wind of qi from the Core until it gives.

name: Switchtroth
description: Trip the opponent at the edge of their balance with the baton behind the heel.

name: Sovereign Weightend
description: Break through the guard with a gale of qi from the Core carried down the shaft.

name: Statute Capend
description: Seal the arm's qi with the Core's steady pulse and keep the hold as long as it is needed.

name: Batonvow
description: Catch a gale-strong blow and turn it back on its source with a half-turn of the baton.

name: Venerable Gripwrap
description: Plant the Core's weight in the ground so no gale can move the stance, and press back any who push.
